# Native Alert Correlation

This workbook displays existing native alerts and cross-product context. Resolve detections in the authoritative Microsoft portal. Sentinel does not reproduce Purview, Defender, or Entra detection logic.

> **Identity privacy:** Raw actor identifiers are sensitive. Limit access to personnel with a need to know, and use masked or pseudonymized reporting views when direct identity is not necessary.

content.query:
M365Gov_NativeAlerts(ago(24h), now())
| summarize AlertCount=count(), Products=dcount(ProductName), Providers=dcount(ProviderName) by ActorIdentifier
| where isnotempty(ActorIdentifier)
| order by AlertCount desc
content.title: Entities represented by native alerts

content.query:
M365Gov_NativeAlerts(ago(24h), now())
| project TimeGenerated, AlertName, AlertSeverity, AlertStatus, ActorIdentifier, ProductName, ProviderName, AuthoritativeControlOwner, NativePortalRoute
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Native alert investigation routing
